title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
description: A statement says all bombers deployed to RAF Fairford have been "re-deployed to their home stations" in the US.

title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
description: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

title: Green Party members back 'Zionism is racism' motion
description: The vote has caused divisions among figures at the top of the party at its conference in Brighton.

title: I'm a classic old school Conservative, says Kemi Badenoch
description: The Tory leader seeks to echo Margaret Thatcher as she sets out her guiding political principles.

title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
description: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
description: Pike's lawyer says doctors are still trying to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

title: British Museum announces changes to ease Bayeux Tapestry queues
description: Measures include extended opening hours, as well as an audio guide and additional seating for visitors.

title: Protesters gather as migrants brought ashore on south coast
description: A dinghy was believed to be carrying 120 migrants, according to French media.

title: Shadow chancellor to unveil Tory plans to cut taxes and regulations
description: Shadow ministers will unveil a series of policies on day two of the Conservative Party conference in Birmingham.
